profile_text.body:
ElevenLabs is an AI voice and audio company that describes itself as providing a platform for generating lifelike speech and deploying voice agents. According to its website, the platform offers access to more than 5,000 voices across more than 70 languages through APIs and SDKs, and the company states it builds its own foundational models, beginning with what it describes as the first human-like voice model. Its text-to-speech models are described by the company as independently rated leading, with options optimized for consistency, latency, or emotional control, all supporting 29 or more languages.

The company organizes its offerings into several product lines: ElevenAgents, aimed at customer experience use cases, and ElevenCreative, aimed at content creation, alongside its core AI voice generator. ElevenLabs describes its broader vision as making communication and creation with technology seamless, positioning itself as serving enterprises, creators, and developers.

The site's held facts flag the core ElevenLabs product under the Voice and Audio category, with a noted risk around voice cloning and the likeness and consent considerations that accompany it. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are currently recorded for the company.
